screens.prompt:
Design the MOBILE responsive version (390px viewport) of the PSF Request Portal Dashboard shown in {{DATA:SCREEN:SCREEN_2}}, adhering strictly to all requirements from DESIGN.md and user specifications:

1. Viewport & Dimensions: Target 390px-wide mobile layout, 100% responsive, zero horizontal overflow, 16px horizontal page gutters, clean vertical rhythm on an 8px grid.

2. Compact Top Bar:
- Replaces desktop sidebar.
- Left: Accessible hamburger button (`aria-label="Open navigation menu"`, `aria-expanded="false"`, min 44x44px touch target) with menu icon.
- Center/Left: "PSF Request Portal" logo/brand mark and wordmark in bold Inter text.
- Right: Requester avatar "ST" circle badge with subtle border, representing Sam Taylor (Requester · Systems Eng).
- Include an accessible slide-over/off-canvas navigation drawer (hidden by default via CSS or interactive `<dialog>`/checkbox pattern with backdrop) containing:
  * Header with "PSF Request Portal" and close button
  * Requester profile summary: "Sam Taylor", "Requester · Systems Eng"
  * Nav links with icons and labels: Dashboard (active, blue wash #E8F6FC, text #006F95, indicator bar), Requests, My Drafts, Export, History.
  * No Admin links, no account-role switch, no version number, no online status dots.
- No bottom navigation bar (must not compete with drawer).

3. Dashboard Header & Primary Action:
- Page title "Dashboard" (24px, font-weight: 600, text #173248) and short subtitle "Your requests, at a glance." (13px, text #526575).
- Prominent full-width or inline 44px min-height primary button "+ New Request" in accessible action blue (`background-color: #006F95`, white text, 8px border radius, bold, focus visible ring).

4. Three Summary Filter Buttons (One Single Horizontal Row):
- Show three compact summary filter buttons side-by-side in one row (flex or 3-column grid):
  * "Open work 19": Selected state, blue surface (`#E8F6FC`), strong border outline (`#006F95` 2px), dark ink text (`#173248`), checkmark/pill icon indicator (`✓ Filtered` or check icon), `aria-pressed="true"`, min 44px touch height.
  * "Overdue 10": Warm orange surface (`#FFF3DA`), subtle border (`#FCA600`), warning icon, dark orange ink (`#8A4700`), `aria-pressed="false"`, min 44px touch height.
  * "Completed 0": Crisp pale green surface (`#EDF8E5`), subtle border (`#69CA00`), check circle icon, green ink (`#28651D`), `aria-pressed="false"`, min 44px touch height.
- Must be native focusable `<button type="button">` elements with accessible labels and `aria-pressed`.
- Compact padding (e.g. 8px 6px), small labels (11-12px) and bold counts (18-20px) to comfortably fit on 390px width without stacking vertically.

5. Search & Filters Disclosure:
- Full-width search input with search icon, placeholder "Search request number or title...", height 42-44px, quiet outline border (`#DCE5EB`), background #FFFFFF, border-radius 8px.
- Compact "Filters" disclosure button right next to or below search (`<details>` or button toggle) with filter icon and badge indicator ("All statuses"). When expanded, reveals "Status" select dropdown and "Clear filters" action button. Does NOT push the queue down with massive clutter when collapsed.

6. Work Queue — List Items (Clean Mobile Cards):
- Titled "Related requests" with "19 total" badge.
- Replaces the 4-column desktop table with 5 clean, compact, readable card/list items (white background `#FFFFFF`, fine border `#DCE5EB`, border-radius 10px, padding 14px, 10px vertical gap).
- DO NOT repeat repetitive column labels like "Request:", "Status:", "Owner:" on every value.
- Exact 5 fictional sample items from the desktop screen:
  1. Title: "S32K3 wafer sort setup" (15px bold, clickable link/button to request detail with hover/focus underline). Number: "PSF-2026-1042" (12px, font-family JetBrains Mono / monospace, color #526575). Status badge: Submitted (pale blue wash, blue border/icon, text #006F95). Due date: "12 Oct 2026". Owner: "Alex Morgan / GNTC".
  2. Title: "LPC55 transfer qualification". Number: "PSF-2026-1041". Status badge: In Progress (pale blue wash, icon, text #006F95). Due date: "10 Oct 2026" with small "Urgent" pill badge (orange/amber tint, not overdue). Owner: "Jamie Lee / MFG".
  3. Title: "i.MX 9 probe validation". Number: "PSF-2026-1040". Status badge: Need More Information (amber wash, icon, text #8A4700). Due date: "01 Oct 2026" highlighted in error ink `#B42332` with distinct "! OVERDUE" badge (`#FFF0F1` bg, `#B42332` text). Owner: "Alex Morgan / GNTC".
  4. Title: "MCX production release". Number: "PSF-2026-1039". Status badge: Submitted. Due date: "15 Oct 2026". Owner: "Unassigned" (italicized gray).
  5. Title: "KW45 BLE transceiver qualification test map". Number: "PSF-2026-1037". Status badge: In Progress. Due date: "22 Oct 2026" with small "High" priority pill badge. Owner: "Elena Rostova / GNTC".
- Each item layout:
  * Top: Title and request number, with a chevron-right or open action affordance.
  * Middle: Status badge with icon and readable text.
  * Bottom row: Due date (with Overdue or priority badges) on the left, Owner / Dept on the right.

7. Pagination Footer:
- Matches exact 25-item page contract: "19 related requests · 25 per page" (text 12px #526575).
- Compact pagination row: "Previous" (disabled), "Page 1 of 1" (12px), "Next" (disabled). No multi-page numbered pills.

8. Visual Polish & Palette:
- Design tokens: Cool canvas background `#F4F7FA`, white containers `#FFFFFF`, ink `#173248`, secondary ink `#526575`, outline `#DCE5EB`, primary blue `#006F95`.
- Font Inter, monospace JetBrains Mono for request IDs.
- High contrast, dark readable text on tinted washes.
- Clean vanilla CSS and SVG icons (Lucide/heroicon style). Fully self-contained. No external CDN failures. Interactive drawer and filter toggle via clean vanilla JS or CSS states.
screens.title: PSF Request Portal — Mobile Dashboard

outputComponents.text:
I have created the mobile responsive version (390px viewport) of the polished PSF Dashboard, directly matching the visual language, NXP-inspired palette, typography, and functional hierarchy established in the desktop reference:

### Summary of Mobile Design Adaptations

1. **Compact Top Bar & Accessible Drawer:**
   - Replaced the desktop sidebar with a 56px top bar containing an accessible hamburger button (`min 44×44px` touch target), the compact **PSF Request Portal** brand mark, and the Requester user avatar (**ST**).
   - An off-canvas navigation drawer slides in smoothly, presenting Sam Taylor's Requester identity, clean navigation links (`Dashboard` active with blue wash and indicator, `Requests`, `My Drafts`, `Export`, `History`), and a close action. No Admin tools, version numbers, or status indicators are exposed.
   - Strictly omitted any bottom navigation bar to avoid competing navigation paradigms.

2. **Streamlined Header & Primary CTA:**
   - Compact page introduction with the **Dashboard** heading and *"Your requests, at a glance."* subtitle.
   - Prominent, full-width **+ New Request** button in accessible action blue (`#006F95`) with a 44px touch target.

3. **Three Summary Filter Buttons in One Row:**
   - Positioned **Open work (19)**, **Overdue (10)**, and **Completed (0)** in a single horizontal row with `min 44px` height and `aria-pressed` states (`true` on Open work, `false` on Overdue and Completed).
   - Styled with compact padding, distinct background tints (`#E8F6FC`, `#FFF3DA`, `#EDF8E5`), dark high-contrast ink, and the outline/check treatment on the active filter.

4. **Search & Collapsible Filter Disclosure:**
   - Full-width keyword search input with search icon.
   - Secondary filters consolidated into a compact **Filter Parameters** disclosure button displaying the active `"All statuses"` badge, avoiding form bloat in the primary viewport while keeping quick access to status filtering and clear actions.

5. **Work Queue List Cards (Clean Mobile Pattern):**
   - Transformed the 4-column desktop table into clean, card-like list rows without repetitive value labels (`Request:`, `Status:`, `Owner:`):
     - **Title & ID**: High-contrast, tappable request title leading visually with the request ID in JetBrains Mono underneath, accompanied by a chevron affordance.
     - **Configurable Status Badges**: Clear text and icon pairings with proper background washes (Submitted, In Progress, Need More Information).
     - **Schedule & Ownership**: Due date on the left and Owner / Department on the right. Only the 01 Oct 2026 row displays the distinct red overdue badge (`! OVERDUE`), while `Urgent` and `High` are shown as independent priority badges.

6. **Pagination Contract:**
   - Retained the exact single-page contract: `"19 related requests · 25 per page"` with disabled Previous and Next actions and `"Page 1 of 1"`. No artificial numbered pages.
   - 16px horizontal gutters throughout, with zero horizontal overflow.

Expand the Filters disclosure to view the status selector and clear action
